## 席位核对

**L1 verdict: ACCEPT** · PR #34488 · card #34462 · first review · read 2026-11-16T23:26Z

Head-sha: `f479813e0c6d6e2b5f431fdeab9672ba75ae318a` (the head named in final-head comment 6932452742)

Read from GitHub at this head (`get_files`, diff, check-runs), not from the report.

**Checklist**
- Shape: draft, base `main`; the body opens with the attribution lines and then `Fixes #34462`. The whole card is delivered, so `Fixes` is right. The other numbers in the body (#34459, #32984, #32749, #34461) have no closing verb next to them.
- Scope: 3 files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, the new pin file beside it, and a root changeset. Nothing unrelated, no `content/docs/releases/`.
- Changeset: root `.changeset/34462-ai-chat-send-order-uploads.md`, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`. Each sentence checked against the diff: "a turn sent while an earlier turn's attachments are still being read waits behind that turn" matches `doSend` chaining on `sendChainRef` whenever `preparingCountRef.current > 0`. "the composer reads as busy" matches `isLoading={isLoading || preparingTurn}`. "An upload that fails releases the busy state, and the turn still sends, naming the file as not read" matches the decrement in `finally`, and `uploadChatAttachments` uses `Promise.allSettled`, so a failed upload becomes a note instead of a throw. "A turn with no attachment is sent at once, as before" matches the synchronous branch when nothing is attached and nothing is being prepared.
- Tests: the new file drives the real `ChatPane` send path, `useChatConversation` and `useObjectChat` transport, and pins the order of the chat POSTs plus the `isLoading` handed to the composer. It has three cases, including a CONTROL. The PR body records two ablations, one per changed behaviour (A1 `await ahead` → 1 red; A2 `preparingTurn` dropped from `isLoading` → 2 red), with the CONTROL green under both.
- Gates: 51 check-runs on this head, all `completed`: 38 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`, Type Check UI `success`, Lint UI `success`, Test UI 1–16 `success`, Build & E2E UI `success`, Live E2E UI `success`, Check Changeset `success`, Governed Surface Queue Guard `success`. The skips are the core-only and opt-in jobs a `ui/`-only diff does not trigger.

**Spot checks (mine)**
1. Ordering holds before React re-renders: `doSend` reads the `preparingCountRef` ref rather than the `preparingTurn` state. So a send that arrives in the same tick as an attachment turn, before `isLoading` reaches the composer, still joins the chain.
2. The chain cannot jam: every link ends in `.catch(() => undefined)`, so `await ahead` never rejects, and the counter is released in `finally`.
3. `onSent` gets the same text as on `main`: `sentText` is the sheet brief without the file notes, which equals `content` when there is no sheet.
4. The page's own `isLoading` still drives canvas refresh, package binding, `PendingDraftsBar` and `onStop`. Only the composer prop is widened.

**Accepted deviations / notes (not REWORK)**
- During an upload the submit button is drawn as Stop but `onStop` is undefined, so it does nothing. The PR body states this and cancelling an upload is outside the card.
- The `prepareTurn(...).catch` fallback sends the bare text without naming the files. It is reachable only on an unexpected throw (the upload path is `allSettled`), and before this PR such a throw lost the turn entirely.

**L2 owed: no.** None of the four contract faces is touched: `Clause-②: no`, no narrowing declared, no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed rule text.

**Landing tier**: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34488` reports 0 of 3 paths governed and +363/−33 = 396 lines ≤ 3000. Ordinary queue landing by the area at this head.
